install: node -e "const [major]=process.versions.node.split('.').map(Number); if (major < 20) { console.error('Node 20+ is required for this workspace.'); process.exit(1); }" && npm -v | node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const version=fs.readFileSync(0,'utf8').trim(); const major=Number(version.split('.')[0]); if (!Number.isFinite(major) || major < 10) { console.error('npm 10+ is required for this workspace.'); process.exit(1); }" && npm ci --no-audit --no-fund && npm run typecheck --workspace=@vmp/api && npm exec --workspace=@vmp/web nuxi prepare && bash scripts/install-coderabbit-cli.sh

git.notes: Pushes to main autodeploy staging. Always branch + PR; CodeRabbit reviews PRs. See AGENTS.md and .cursor/rules/git-workflow.mdc.

agent.notes: When touching anything related to MoQ livestreams, follow the instructions at https://doc.moq.dev/setup/agent/prompt.md (see AGENTS.md and .cursor/rules/moq-livestreams.mdc). CodeRabbit CLI is installed via scripts/install-coderabbit-cli.sh (cr / coderabbit on PATH). For local review before commit: run `cr review --agent` (or `cr review --agent --uncommitted`) in the background — reviews can take several minutes — then fix critical findings and optionally re-run once. Prefer --agent for structured JSON. Auth uses env secret CODERABBIT_API_KEY (Agentic API key); optional CODERABBIT_REGION=eu for EU orgs. See https://docs.coderabbit.ai/cli/overview.
